gbm_population_evidence.quote: Glioblastoma, Recurrent; Lower Grade Glioma, Recurrent

Histopathologically-confirmed, supratentorial GBM or lower-grade gliomas (such as oligodendroglioma, astrocytoma, oligoastrocytoma, anaplastic astrocytoma, anaplastic oligodendroglioma or anaplastic oligoastrocytoma);

candidate_evidence.quote: Study of Recombinant Human Endostatin Combined with Temozolomide and Irinotecan in Recurrent Gliomas

On the basis of prior clinical experience, we carry out this prospective trial to confirm the efficacy and safety of the combination of rh-ES, temozolomide and irinotecan in patients with recurrent gliomas.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Glioblastoma, Recurrent; Lower Grade Glioma, Recurrent

role_evidence.quote: Study of Recombinant Human Endostatin Combined with Temozolomide and Irinotecan in Recurrent Gliomas

Recombinant human endostatin (rh-ES) is an endogenous broad-spectrum angiogenesis inhibitor that has been shown to significantly improve therapeutic efficacy when combining with conventional chemotherapy agents in non-small-cell lung cancer, breast cancer and melanoma.

agents.drug_class_hint: recombinant human endostatin (rh-ES; anti-angiogenic protein, approved in China for NSCLC)

role_evidence.quote: After temozolomide rechallenge or combination with irinotecan, the progression-free survival rate at 6 months (PFS-6%) of recurrent glioblastoma was about 21%.
Irinotecan was administrated 125mg/m2 on day 1 and day 15.

flag.reason: Irinotecan is framed as part of the cytotoxic chemotherapy backbone (TMZ + irinotecan) to which rh-ES is added, but it is not GBM standard of care and could be an experimental_combination candidate

role_evidence.quote: Temozolomide was given orally 200mg/m2 for 5 days in each cycle.

coder_notes: Single registered intervention bundles rh-endostatin, temozolomide and irinotecan; split into rows sharing a regimen_id. Title frames rh-ES as the agent added to a cytotoxic temozolomide + irinotecan regimen (the summary cites prior TMZ +/- irinotecan results), so rh-ES coded experimental_monotherapy and irinotecan/temozolomide soc_backbone; if irinotecan is treated as investigational both would be experimental_combination (candidate status of rh-ES unchanged). No INN in record for rh-ES; registered name used as moiety. Two experimental cohorts by histology (GBM vs lower-grade glioma), no control. Older histology terms (oligoastrocytoma, anaplastic) suggest pre-CNS5 usage but no WHO edition or IDH reference, so cns5_terminology unclear.
